headline.text: L1 S3 MM5 missing screw never recovered — *2 pallets* held 4.5h, released after investigation found all arm pieces accounted for at X-ray.

summary: Three hardware-in-product events in 24 hours: L1 S3 MM5 missing screw (held/released), MM3 broken arm caught by X-ray with metal confirmed, and L3 ML1 missing C6 bolt plus damaged conveyor belts. L1 S1 chiller faulted repeatedly causing tunnel temps to spike; dark caramel particles approved to run.

holds.title: S3 MM5 missing screw — 2 pallets held, released
holds.summary: Operator noticed missing screw on MM5 bag-opening arm base at 01:30; pallets from 01:30–02:15 window held pending investigation; screw never found but all arm pieces accounted for; released at 06:32.
holds.status: Resolved — pallets released after confirming all hardware accounted for via X-ray inspection and arm replacement verification.

food_safety.title: S3 MM3 broken arm — metal detected in pouch
food_safety.summary: MM3 bag-opening arm broke at 10:31; X-ray rejected piece; pouch opened and metal confirmed inside; maintenance replaced arm.
food_safety.status: Resolved — X-ray caught reject, metal piece recovered, arm replaced, system functioning as designed.

food_safety.title: ML1 missing bolt and damaged belts
food_safety.summary: C6 belt missing bolt at 22:50, maintenance replaced; belts C4/C5 show fiber damage and excessive cutting at 07:09, flagged for maintenance inspection.
food_safety.status: Bolt replaced; fiber damage on C4/C5 conveyor belts flagged to maintenance for inspection — no line stoppage, monitoring ongoing.

quality.title: S1 chiller faulting — tunnel temps spiked to 10°C
quality.summary: Chiller faulted 3+ times across shifts; tunnel 2 rose from 3°C setpoint to 10°C at 10:59, causing soft chocolate; line paused 17 min to recover temp.
quality.status: Open — chiller intermittently faulting, Sollich contacted via email; operators monitoring tunnel temp closely and resetting as needed.

quality.title: ML1 dirty molds and cold almonds
quality.summary: Dirty molds causing film jams and bowing/heavy weights at 01:54; almond temp 74°F (too cold) discovered at 08:33; inclusion hopper emptying standard established.
quality.status: Resolved — cleaner molds producing best bars by 10:12; new standard to empty inclusion hopper during rotary valve jams.

quality.title: ML4 bar appearance issues at TG5
quality.summary: Bars with poor back-side appearance at TG5 starting 10:57; operator pulling defects but volume exceeds removal capacity.
quality.status: Open at window close — Nelson adjusted gondola earlier (resolved first occurrence at 09:03), issue recurred at 10:57, active at 11:27.

quality.title: S2 caramel bleeding in jars
quality.summary: Decent amount of bleeding caramels observed at 12:13; inspection found ~10% of pieces showing bubbles intermittently; no soft/watery texture confirmed.
quality.status: Closed — QA inspected, caramel temp slope within range, hypothesized chocolate texture contributor but not confirmed as root cause.

quality.title: S1 dark particles in caramel
quality.summary: Dark particles detected in caramel at 07:10; QA approved to run after inspection.
quality.status: Resolved — Mary Montilla approved caramel for running after visual inspection.

quality.title: Truffle underweight pieces
quality.summary: Weight checks at 03:25 found underweight truffles; south last 2 lanes most affected; shaker adjusted, sorter positioned to remove.
quality.status: Resolved — weight corrected by 05:18, QA verified spec compliance.

opportunities.text: Consider adding bag-opening arm hardware inspection to MM5 pre-shift checklist — today's missing screw echoes the MM3 broken arm, both in bag-handling equipment.
Consider adding conveyor belt integrity check to ML1 startup — today's C6 missing bolt and C4/C5 fiber damage suggest belt hardware needs systematic attention.
Review ML1 almond inclusion hopper protocols — today's 74°F temp discovery (vs required warm temp for chocolate deposit) drove new standard to empty hopper during rotary valve jams.
